# Nafasat Dental & Aesthetics

> Private dental clinic on Main Boulevard, NFC Society Phase 1, Lahore, Pakistan, opposite Central Park. Led by Dr Hamza Mahmood (BDS, RDS, C-IMPLANT, C-ORTHO), PMDC registered dental surgeon, with visiting consultant specialists in oral and maxillofacial surgery, periodontics and endodontics. Open Monday to Saturday, 4 PM to 10 PM. Sunday closed.

## Key facts
- Name: Nafasat Dental & Aesthetics (Urdu: نفاست)
- Type: Dental clinic, dentist, cosmetic dentist, dental implants provider
- Address: Plot 110-C, Main Boulevard, NFC Society Phase 1, First Floor, Opposite Central Park, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Landmarks: Same row as Pizza Hut NFC, near the roundabout where NFC meets Valencia Town. Close to Wapda Town, Valencia Town and College Road
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/dz7TWAivzHWQiUwy8
- Coordinates: 31.4155062, 74.2684827
- Phone and WhatsApp: +92 339 6699111
- Email: nafasatdental@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 4 PM to 10 PM. Sunday closed. Appointments by call or WhatsApp
- Payments: Cash, card (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfer, JazzCash, Easypaisa
- Areas served: NFC Society, Valencia Town, Wapda Town, Johar Town, College Road, Township and nearby areas of Lahore

## Dentist
- [Dr Hamza Mahmood](https://nafasatdental.com/dr-hamza-mahmood.html): BDS, RDS, C-IMPLANT, C-ORTHO, PMDC 942269-01-D. Founder and lead dental surgeon.
